orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Gauntling Overclock Engine, a hull mount (outward is up): a big pale steel bell and a smaller rust-coloured bell welded side by side, copper coils wound round both necks and cyan arcs that jump between the two rims and a spike between them on the loop; inside a core with a copper-wound coil stack, a knife switch on the front and mismatched plates. Damaged: the rust bell is bent over and sputtering, a coil unwound and sparking, an arc stuck on, the core coil scorched. Disabled: the big bell broken off its neck, the rust bell hanging, windings burnt, the core dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
